purpose.zh: 让上背转动更灵活，拉伸胸口和肩膀前面
purpose.en: Loosen up your upper back and stretch your chest and the front of your shoulder.

text.zh: 双膝并拢，上面的手臂画个大弧往后打开
text.en: Keep your knees together and sweep your top arm back in a big arc

text.zh: 侧躺，头枕垫子，髋和膝盖都弯成直角。
text.en: Lie on your side, head on a cushion, hips and knees bent at right angles.
Follow your hand with your eyes.

commonErrors.zh: 膝盖分开或屁股往后翻
commonErrors.en: Letting the knees separate or the hips roll back.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时，幅度小一点或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, move less far or switch to an easier version.

changes: purpose 去掉「胸椎旋转」改口语
